troubleshootingGuides.Crashes on Launch: Check if libil2cpp.so symbols match your target target architecture (ARM64 / v8a). Verify NDK build alignment.
troubleshootingGuides.Missing Libraries: Ensure custom .so files are placed in /lib/arm64-v8a/ inside the APK before re-aligning and zipaligning.
troubleshootingGuides.Banned / Flagged: Avoid hooking directly into Oculus Platform / OpenXR entitlement verification methods in libovrloader.so.
